_readme: S401 SkyManzanita, 2026-10-16. Los Medanos's capture-only read (run 38978063188) found 7 program pages, all Art's: the registry's start page is the Art department (/catalog/26-27/art) and the fast read stops at the first menu that names programs. This read prints the menu's other links, to see how its departments or hubs are addressed. Read 2 (S401): read 1 (run 38978810670) shows Art's page lists its awards and ends "Back to department listing"; the menu's Program Requirements, Courses, and Student Learning Outcomes is 26-27/courses. This read takes that page's links, to see how its departments are addressed. Read 3 (S401): the capture under #2179's walk (run 38982485062) read the menu's 11 one-segment pages and found no further program: courses' content call holds no link to degrees, though the rendered page lists it. This read loads courses and degrees rendered, with network: true, to see which calls the catalog's scripts make for a section's topics and what a content call's links look like.
